note: Crafts of the emotional_logical axis — a horizon Reach now brought online. Pathos is the emotional-pole tradition (feeling as force, resonance-of-heart); Logos the logical-pole (reason as force, inference-as-power). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with the Deepfeelers / the Reasoners. Both drift the wielder toward their pole. Function tags included per canon. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 — first horizon-axis tradition.

abilities.name: Pathos
abilities.narrationHints: Feeling made a force — the true emotion of a room surfaced, a grief shared and eased, a passion kindled or cooled by one who feels it first and hardest.
abilities.description: The emotional-pole mastery: reading, moving, and sharing feeling as a real force. Not manipulation — resonance; the Deepfeelers' art.
abilities.notFor: Forcing a feeling on the unwilling (Pathos resonates, it does not compel); cold analysis (that's Logos); faking an emotion — Pathos works by feeling it truly first.

tree.name: The Open Heart
tree.grants: Feel the true emotion under a room or a person, past what they show; share a feeling so it eases (a grief halved, a fear steadied); kindle a genuine passion in the willing.
tree.cannot: Reads and shares; does not command; the guarded can close to it; feeling their pain means feeling it.

tree.name: The Shared Fire
tree.grants: Move a crowd by feeling-with-them; carry a person through an emotion too big to bear alone; make an unspoken feeling undeniable in the open.
tree.cannot: You take on what you move — the cost is real; a will set against feeling resists; moving a mob is riding a wave, not steering it.

tree.name: The Deep Chord
tree.grants: Feeling at the scale of peoples — turn a room, a mob, a mourning-crowd by the truth of shared feeling; reach a heart no reason could; hold another's whole emotional weight for a time. The Deepfeelers' power in miniature.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts emotion-hot — feeling everything, all the time, until the self drowns; emotion without reason to shape it becomes storm, and a storm forecloses on thought as surely as ice does on feeling.

rankDeltas.delta: MOVE A CROWD by feeling-with-them; CARRY A PERSON THROUGH AN EMOTION TOO BIG TO BEAR ALONE
FEELING AT THE SCALE OF PEOPLES — turn a room, a mob, a mourning-crowd by the TRUTH of shared feeling

intensity.conserve: share a little — half the effect, and you take on less
intensity.surge: double it; THE WIELDER DRIFTS EMOTION-HOT, feeling everything, all the time

bounds.text: READS AND SHARES readily; SETTING a feeling that was not there is far harder, and the guarded can close
YOU TAKE ON WHAT YOU MOVE — the cost is real
A WILL SET AGAINST YOU IS SET AGAINST YOU
the wielder DRIFTS EMOTION-HOT

abilities.name: Logos
abilities.narrationHints: Reason made a force — an argument that lands like a blow, a contradiction exposed, a conclusion so clean it changes what people must do.
abilities.description: The logical-pole mastery: inference, argument, and proof as real forces that move minds and situations. The Reasoners' art.
abilities.notFor: Reaching a heart set against reason (that's Pathos); wisdom (Logos is valid, not necessarily wise); a premise that's false — Logos builds truly on what it's given, garbage in and all.

tree.name: The Clear Argument
tree.grants: Build an argument that compels the reasonable; expose a contradiction so it can't be unseen; deduce a hidden fact from what's present.
tree.cannot: The unreasonable and the emotion-ruled resist; a valid argument from a false premise still lands false.

tree.name: The Binding Proof
tree.grants: Prove a thing so cleanly the proof itself changes what people must do; corner a liar in their own logic; model a situation and derive its necessary outcome.
tree.cannot: Proof binds the honest and the logical; the Cathedral of Convincing (true pieces, false whole) survives it; a proof of the unwelcome can be refused by force.

tree.name: The Necessary Conclusion
tree.grants: Reason at the scale of peoples — an argument a whole council cannot answer, a contradiction that topples a doctrine, a conclusion so inescapable it reorganises what everyone present thought they knew. And turned on one person: a contradiction opened in what they have built themselves on, which does not wound the body and takes the ground out from under them all the same. They will keep standing. They will not keep believing.
tree.cannot: It needs something true to work with — Logos cannot prove a falsehood, only forge one that the next sound mind unpicks. It fails against those who will simply refuse a true conclusion. And the Syllogists hold that a person you have taken apart this way is owed the time to rebuild, which is a debt many of them do not pay.

mechanic.note: damaging — 'thought as force' in the argumentative register. Compare cogitant's noesis (also damaging, also mental): noesis out-thinks a SITUATION, logos out-argues a PERSON.

rankDeltas.delta: PROVE A THING SO CLEANLY THE PROOF ITSELF CHANGES WHAT PEOPLE MUST DO; CORNER A LIAR IN THEIR OWN LOGIC
REASON AT THE SCALE OF PEOPLES — an argument A WHOLE COUNCIL CANNOT ANSWER, a contradiction THAT TOPPLES A DOCTRINE

intensity.conserve: make the point — half the force, and it invites reply
intensity.surge: double it; A VALID ARGUMENT IS NOT A TRUE ONE, and the unreasonable simply resist

bounds.text: THE UNREASONABLE AND THE EMOTION-RULED RESIST
A VALID ARGUMENT IS NOT A TRUE ONE
PROOF BINDS THE HONEST AND THE LOGICAL — THE CATHEDRAL OF CERTAINTY IS NEITHER
IT NEEDS SOMETHING TRUE TO WORK WITH — Logos cannot prove what is not so

abilities.name: The Turning Word
abilities.narrationHints: The room turns — a crowd, a court, a mob — moved as one by the exact true thing said the exact right way.
abilities.description: The social capstone: move a whole gathering at once — turn a hostile crowd, sway a council, stop a mob — by finding and speaking the one thing that reaches all of them. Pathos and Logos fused into mass persuasion.
abilities.notFor: Individual mind-control; moving those with no shared feeling or reason; forcing against a set will.

tree.name: The Turning Word
tree.grants: Turn a crowd or council decisively — the room moves as one when you find the word that reaches them.
tree.cannot: Needs a real shared chord to strike; a crowd set immovably resists; you feel/carry what you move.

tree.name: The Word That Holds
tree.grants: The turning holds past the moment — a crowd moved stays moved after you have gone, a council's decision keeps its shape when you are not in the room. And where there is no shared chord to strike, you can make one: name the thing they did not know they held in common. A room turned off something ugly does not merely stop: the turning closes the rift that was opening in it, and people who were a minute from being enemies go back to being neighbours.
tree.cannot: A chord you made is a chord you are answerable for; the Rhetors hold that inventing a commonality is how peoples are built and also how they are ruined. It still cannot move a will genuinely set. And you carry what you move for as long as it stays moved.

rankDeltas.delta: THE TURNING HOLDS PAST THE MOMENT — a crowd moved STAYS moved after you have gone; a council's decision keeps

intensity.conserve: reach a few — half the scope, and nobody feels handled
intensity.surge: double it; A CHORD YOU MADE IS A CHORD YOU ARE ANSWERABLE FOR

bounds.text: NEEDS A REAL SHARED CHORD TO STRIKE — a crowd set immovably resists
A CHORD YOU MADE IS A CHORD YOU ARE ANSWERABLE FOR

abilities.name: The Correct Protocol
abilities.narrationHints: He knew exactly what was wrong. The treatment followed.
abilities.description: Heal through precise diagnosis and correct procedure — the methodical application of what is known to work.

tree.name: Correct Diagnosis
tree.grants: Diagnose and treat through methodical application of what is known to work — no guesswork, no comfort, the correct intervention.

tree.name: By Protocol
tree.grants: Restore through proper sequence — the correct actions done in the correct order return the body or system to function without anything left out.

tree.name: Root Cause
tree.grants: Restore completely by identifying the underlying cause and applying the full chain of correct interventions — nothing unaddressed, no relapse from what was left.

abilities.name: The Proved Position
abilities.narrationHints: He had proved it. They could attack him all they liked. The proof still stood.
abilities.description: Protect through irrefutable argument — attacks on a proved position must answer the proof before they can land.

tree.name: Proved Ground

tree.name: The Extended Proof
tree.grants: Extend the proved position to cover a space or a group — a claim so airtight it functions as a ward against what depends on its denial.

tree.name: The Self-Maintaining Proof

mechanic.note: A SIXTEENTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC — PROVED: a TYPED guard (rhetorical/social attacks) whose soak is the soundness of your position. 'Attacks must first ANSWER THE PROOF.' Transparent to a blade.

abilities.narrationHints: He hadn't walked it. He had worked it out.
abilities.description: Navigate through pure reasoning — derive the correct path from what you know before taking a step.

tree.name: Reasoned Path
tree.grants: Navigate any space by reasoning about it — what must be true about the layout, the route, the exits — without needing to see it first.

tree.name: Inferred Route
tree.grants: Derive the correct path through unknown territory by inference — from what you know about the type of space, the likely structure, the probable exits.

tree.name: The Necessary Route

abilities.narrationHints: The certainty was enough. The axiom held and therefore so did he.
abilities.description: Sustain through the certainty of what you know — fear, pain, and doubt don't reach the level of the axioms.

tree.name: Axiomatic Ground
tree.grants: Hold function under pressure through the certainty of what you know — fear, pain, and doubt operate below the level the axioms hold.

tree.name: The Correct Sequence
tree.grants: Sustain across a hard stretch through pure logical discipline — the sequence of correct actions that keeps you going regardless of how you feel about them.

tree.name: The Axiom Holds
tree.grants: As long as what you know is true remains true, you remain functional around it. The axiom is the ground and the ground does not give.

rankDeltas.delta: sustain through PURE LOGICAL DISCIPLINE — the sequence of correct actions that keeps you going when feeling would not
SPECIAL: as long as WHAT YOU KNOW IS TRUE REMAINS TRUE, you remain functional around it — the axiom is the ground and the ground holds

abilities.name: The Inescapable Conclusion
abilities.narrationHints: You lay the premises down one at a time, each one they must agree to, until they arrive — of their own reasoning — at a conclusion they would have run from if they'd seen it coming.
abilities.description: The Syllogist art of the inescapable argument — a chain of reasoning so sound that agreeing to the start compels agreeing to the end, binding a mind by its own logic. Not deception; the opposite. The trap is that it is TRUE.
abilities.notFor: It binds only the reasonable — a mind that will simply refuse a true conclusion cannot be caught by one. And a true argument binds you too; you cannot walk someone to a conclusion you are unwilling to stand on yourself.

tree.name: The Inescapable Conclusion
tree.grants: Bind a reasoning mind to a conclusion by an argument it cannot honestly escape.
tree.cannot: It fails against those who refuse reason itself, it binds its wielder to the same truth, and a conclusion someone was walked into by force of logic can curdle into resentment of the one who walked them.

tree.name: The Standing Proof
tree.grants: Walk a whole body of reasoning minds to the same conclusion at once — a council, a court, a school — and the binding holds against later private doubt, because each of them watched the others agree. The chain can be built across days now rather than one exchange.
tree.cannot: It still fails entirely against those who will simply refuse a true conclusion, and a group holds more of them than a person does. It binds you to the same truth, publicly and on the record. And a conclusion a body was walked into together curdles together — the Syllogists have begun more than one schism this way.

rankDeltas.delta: WALK A WHOLE BODY OF REASONING MINDS to the same conclusion AT ONCE — a council, a court, a school

intensity.conserve: make the argument — half the binding, and they can still walk away thinking
intensity.surge: double it; IT STILL FAILS ENTIRELY against those who will simply REFUSE

bounds.text: IT FAILS AGAINST THOSE WHO REFUSE REASON ITSELF
it binds A REASONING MIND — the unreasoning are outside it entirely

abilities.name: The Proof
abilities.narrationHints: You assemble it whole — the complete proof, every step airtight, of a thing that is simply TRUE — and lay it before the world, and the world has no honest answer but to accept it.
abilities.description: The Syllogist capstone — a complete, irrefutable proof of a true thing, assembled and offered so soundly that no honest mind can deny it. The deepest gift of the logical kind, and the loneliest: to be right past all argument is to be right, often, alone.
abilities.notFor: One proof, once, at enormous cost — it can only prove what is actually true; there is no proof of a falsehood, only clever forgery that the next sound mind unpicks. And a proof, once offered, is loose in the world; you cannot un-prove a thing.

tree.name: The Proof
tree.grants: Assemble and offer a complete, irrefutable proof of a true thing.
tree.cannot: It proves only the true, it costs nearly all you have, and to be irrefutably right is a lonely country — the proof convinces, but conviction is not love.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: ASSEMBLE AND OFFER A COMPLETE, IRREFUTABLE PROOF of a true thing. The capstone is a KIND (irrefutability itself) at near-total cost.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a partial proof is an argument, and arguments are what the Cathedral survives.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — it already costs nearly all you have.

bounds.text: IT PROVES ONLY THE TRUE
IT COSTS NEARLY ALL YOU HAVE

abilities.name: The Shared Grief
abilities.narrationHints: You take up the lament and others find their own grief given shape in it — not lessened, but no longer carried alone, the weight spread across every voice that joins.
abilities.description: The Threnodist art of the shared lament — a song of grief that lets many carry one sorrow together, so no single heart bears the whole. The mourning-singers' first true gift.
abilities.notFor: It shares grief, it does not erase it — a sorrow sung together is still a sorrow. And the one who leads the lament carries the gathering-point; you hold the grief of all who join while you sing.

tree.name: The Shared Grief
tree.grants: Lead a shared lament that spreads one grief across many, so none carries it alone.
tree.cannot: It cannot remove grief, only distribute its weight; the singer bears the gathering of it; and a grief shared is a grief made real to everyone who joins the song.

tree.name: The Named Sorrow
tree.grants: The lament finds the true shape of what is mourned. Singing it, you perceive what the grief is ACTUALLY for — the loss beneath the stated one — and those who join hear it named as well, often for the first time.
tree.cannot: Naming is not mending; a sorrow correctly named can wound worse before it eases. The singer cannot choose what surfaces, and what the lament names in company cannot be unnamed.

tree.name: The Long Lament
tree.grants: Hold a lament across days rather than a night, and across a settlement rather than a room — a whole community may carry one loss together until it is bearable. The gathering-point can be handed to another singer, so the lament outlasts any one voice.
tree.cannot: You hold the gathering while you hold the lament, and days of it mark the singer; handing the point on requires a singer able to take it; and a grief carried by everyone becomes part of what that place IS — the GM records it in the world, not the character.

rankDeltas.delta: the lament FINDS THE TRUE SHAPE OF WHAT IS MOURNED — singing it, you perceive what the grief is ACTUALLY for
hold a lament ACROSS DAYS and ACROSS A SETTLEMENT — a whole community mourning as one

intensity.conserve: a short lament — half the distribution, and it asks little of the gathering
intensity.surge: double it; YOU HOLD THE GATHERING WHILE YOU HOLD THE LAMENT

bounds.text: IT CANNOT REMOVE GRIEF, ONLY DISTRIBUTE ITS WEIGHT
NAMING IS NOT MENDING — a sorrow correctly named CAN WOUND

abilities.name: The Names of the Lost
abilities.narrationHints: You sing the names — all of them, every one lost — and for the length of the song they are not gone, exactly; they are HELD, present in the keeping of their names.
abilities.description: The Threnodist art of the naming-song — a lament that holds the lost present through the keeping of their names, so that for a while the dead are not absent but attended. The deep work of those who refuse to let go be the same as forget.
abilities.notFor: It holds the lost in memory, it does not return them — a name kept is not a life restored. And to sing all the names is to carry all the losses at once, for the length of the song and after.

tree.name: The Names of the Lost
tree.grants: Sing the names of the lost, holding them present in memory for the length of the lament.
tree.cannot: It cannot restore the dead, only attend them; it lays every named loss on the singer at once; and the song ends, and they are gone again, and you chose to feel that twice.

tree.name: The Kept Names
tree.grants: The names keep past the lament. Sung over a place — a barrow, a battlefield, a hall — the attending holds without you, and any who come after feel the lost attended there. The song can hold names you were told rather than only names you carried yourself. Those who hear the names are strengthened by the attending — steadied, clearer about what they are doing and why, and harder to move off it.
tree.cannot: It still does not return them; a name kept is not a life restored. A place that holds its lost is a place that does not move on, which is not always mercy. And a name taken from another's telling is held on trust — sing one wrong and the Threnodists count it a wound.

rankDeltas.delta: THE NAMES KEEP PAST THE LAMENT — sung over a place (a barrow, a battlefield, a hall), THE ATTENDING HOLDS WITHOUT YOU
rankDeltas.from: r2 grants — an EIGHTH autonomy-increment craft

intensity.conserve: sing a few names — half the duration, and the lament closes cleanly

bounds.text: IT CANNOT RESTORE THE DEAD, ONLY ATTEND THEM
A NAME KEPT IS NOT A LIFE RETURNED

abilities.name: The Last Lament
abilities.narrationHints: You sing the whole of it — every grief you have ever held, gathered into one lament so complete that those who hear it are, at the end, somehow lighter, having grieved fully at last the thing they never finished grieving.
abilities.description: The Threnodist capstone — the complete lament, all grief given full voice at once, that lets those who hear it finally finish a mourning they could not finish alone. The greatest and costliest gift of the singers: to be grieved completely is to be freed.
abilities.notFor: One lament, once, at enormous cost — it lets others complete a grief, but the singer must carry the whole of it to give it, and a grief fully sung is fully felt. It cannot make loss not have happened; it can only let it be, at last, mourned.

tree.name: The Last Lament
tree.grants: Sing a complete lament that lets all who hear finish a grief they could not finish alone.
tree.cannot: It costs nearly all you have, it makes the singer feel every grief entire, and it does not undo loss — it only, mercifully, completes the mourning of it.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: sing a COMPLETE LAMENT that lets ALL WHO HEAR FINISH A GRIEF THEY COULD NOT FINISH ALONE. The capstone is a KIND (completing what could not be completed) at near-total cost — AND THE SINGER FEELS EVERY GRIEF IN IT.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a half-sung lament leaves a grief half-finished, which is worse than not beginning.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — the singer already feels every grief in it.

bounds.text: IT COSTS NEARLY ALL YOU HAVE
THE SINGER FEELS EVERY GRIEF IN IT

abilities.name: The Grief That Stops
abilities.narrationHints: They set it down inside them the way you would set down a stone. The heart is not built to carry that.
abilities.description: ⚠️ THE HEART-TUNERS' CRAFT. Pathos SHARES a feeling; this INSTALLS one at a weight no body holds. Not sorrow — sorrow's full weight, all at once, without the years that usually come with it. Some hearts stop. Most do not, and those people are changed.
abilities.notFor: A heart with nothing to grieve — it uses THEIR losses, not invented ones, so someone who has lost nothing is nearly immune. And it CANNOT BE AIMED at an outcome: you set the weight down, the body decides.

tree.name: The Grief That Stops
tree.grants: Set the full weight of their own losses on them at once. They are overwhelmed and afterward not the same.
tree.cannot: Inventing a grief. Anyone who has lost nothing.

tree.name: All Of It
tree.grants: Set every loss down together with nothing held back. A heart sometimes stops. You will not know beforehand which.
tree.cannot: Knowing beforehand. Taking it back once set.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ A HOBBLE WITH A LETHAL TAIL — the kill is a possibility, never a roll you aim. Resolve r2 as incapacitation plus a small independent chance of a stopped heart, weighted by how much the target has actually lost. NOT a FIGHT craft: it does not fight.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: every loss at once, nothing held back — a heart sometimes stops

intensity.surge: all of it; YOU WILL NOT KNOW BEFOREHAND WHICH

bounds.text: IT USES THEIR OWN LOSSES — someone who has lost nothing is nearly immune

abilities.name: The Closing Argument
abilities.narrationHints: Every step is one they agreed to. That is what makes the last step impossible to refuse.
abilities.description: ⚠️ THE CORNERS' CRAFT. A Syllogist walks a person, honestly, from premises they already hold to a conclusion that ends them — that the work was worthless, that they cannot be forgiven, that the only consistent act remaining is the one they will now perform. NOTHING IN IT IS FALSE. That is the whole horror.
abilities.notFor: Anyone who will not reason — the unreasonable are genuinely immune and the Corners resent it. And it CANNOT USE A FALSE PREMISE: the argument must be sound or it does nothing at all.

tree.name: The Closing Argument
tree.grants: Walk them, honestly, to a conclusion that unmakes their footing. They cannot act against it while it holds.
tree.cannot: A false premise. Anyone who refuses to follow.

tree.name: The Only Consistent Act
tree.grants: Reach the conclusion where the consistent act is a final one — and STOP TALKING. What they do next is theirs.
tree.cannot: Making them. It is their hand and both of you know it.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY KILL IN THE CATALOG THE WIELDER DOES NOT PERFORM. Resolve as a hobble; the lethal outcome is the target's OWN act, gated on the argument being sound and the target being a reasoner. The engine should never render it as damage dealt.
